130	#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案
131	
132	**练习 1**：`Trainer` 每个 step 调用 `optim_step()` 之后为什么还要调 `zero_grads()`？如果不调会发生什么？
133	
134	<details>
135	<summary>参考答案</summary>
136	
137	因为 `train_batch` 里的反向传播是**累加**语义——PyTorch 的 `loss.backward()` 把梯度加到 `param.grad` 上而不是覆盖。若不清零，下一个 step 的梯度会叠在上一个 step 的梯度之上，相当于用了一个错误的、不断膨胀的梯度去更新参数。注意 `Trainer` 在每个 epoch 开头也额外调了一次 `zero_grads()`（[trainer.py:L1688](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/trainer.py#L1688)），保证跨 epoch 边界也是干净的。
138	</details>
139	
140	**练习 2**：为什么 `TrainModule` 要继承 PyTorch 的 `Stateful` 接口，而不是只提供普通的 `state_dict()` 方法？
141	
142	<details>
143	<summary>参考答案</summary>
144	
145	`Stateful` 是 `torch.distributed.checkpoint` 认识的标准接口：分布式 checkpoint 保存时会把实现了它的对象当作一个整体单元，自动处理「哪些张量在本 rank、如何分片聚合」的细节。继承它之后，`Trainer` / `Checkpointer` 可以直接把 train module 塞进保存清单，无需为模型和优化器各写一套分片逻辑（u6-l4 展开）。
146	</details>
147	
148	**练习 3**：`train_batch(batch, dry_run=True)` 的 `dry_run` 参数是干什么用的？谁会传 `True`？
149	
150	<details>
151	<summary>参考答案</summary>
152	
153	用于「只走一遍前向反向、不记录指标、不产生副作用」的预热。`Trainer._dry_run_batch()`（[trainer.py:L1660-L1668](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/trainer.py#L1660-L1668)）在正式训练前用一个 mock batch 调用它，目的是提前触发显存分配、编译等一次性开销，避免第一步训练的计时与显存统计失真。
154	</details>
155	
156	### 4.2 TransformerTrainModule 的构建：并行配置为何挂在这里
157	
158	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
159	
160	`TransformerTrainModule` 是 `TrainModule` 面向本库所有 `Transformer` 实现的具体落地。它的 `__init__` 干两件大事：**把模型并行化**、**构建优化器**。它的配置 `TransformerTrainModuleConfig` 上挂着一排显眼的字段：`dp_config`、`tp_config`、`cp_config`、`ep_config`、`pp_config`、`ac_config`（激活检查点）。
161	
162	初学者常有的疑问是：**这些并行配置为什么不放在 `TransformerConfig`（模型图纸）上，而要放在 train module 上？** 三个理由：
163	
164	1. **时序约束**：并行化必须发生在「模型 build 完成之后、优化器 build 之前」。FSDP 会把参数切成 DTensor 分片，优化器必须看到**最终形态**的参数才能正确建参数组（回忆 u5-l1：`OptimGroupOverride` 按参数全限定名分组，`MuPConfig` 按 `fan_in` 算乘数——这些都要求参数已经定型）。模型 build（u3-l2）发生在这条链路更早的位置，它不知道也不该知道训练时怎么切。
165	2. **静态图纸 vs 运行时环境**：`TransformerConfig` 是纯静态的「形状说明书」，序列化进 checkpoint 也只有形状信息；而并行配置依赖**运行时**的 world size、device mesh、GPU 数量——同一份模型配置，8 卡和 64 卡要用不同的并行方案。把二者分开，模型配置才能在不同集群间复用。
166	3. **数据并行的进程组要交还给 Trainer**：`Trainer` 切数据、归约指标都需要知道数据并行进程组（`dp_process_group`），这个组是世界网格（world mesh）划分的产物，而网格正是 train module 在构建时创建的。
167	
168	家族里还有几个兄弟实现（见 [train_module/__init__.py:L8-L25](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/__init__.py#L8-L25) 的再导出清单）：`TransformerPipelineTrainModule`（开流水线时分发到的版本）、`OLMoDDPTrainModule`（配合融合 MoE 分布式优化器）、`MultimodalTransformerTrainModule`（多模态）。
169	
170	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
171	
172	`TransformerTrainModuleConfig.build(model)` 的完整链路：
173	
174	```text
175	TransformerTrainModuleConfig.build(model, device)
176	        │
177	        ├─ pp_config 为 None？
178	        │     ├─ 是 → TransformerTrainModule(model, ...)
179	        │     └─ 否 → TransformerPipelineTrainModule(model, ...)
180	        │
181	TransformerTrainModule.__init__:
182	        ① 校验 rank_microbatch_size % max_sequence_length == 0
183	        ② is_distributed()? → build_world_mesh(dp, tp, cp, ep)   # 多维并行的进程网格
184	           （非分布式却给了并行配置 → 直接报错）
185	        ③ parallelize_model(model, ...)   # 按固定顺序套并行包装：
186	           PP → FP8 → CP → TP → EP → 激活检查点 → compile → DP → init_weights
187	        ④ optim.build(model, strict=True) # 优化器最后建（看到的是分片后的参数）
188	           （eval_only=True 时跳过，self.optim = None）
189	```
190	
191	`parallelize_model` 的顺序是**强制固定**的，不能随意调换：例如 TP 必须在 EP 之后检查「TP + EP 未实现」；DP 的 FSDP 包装必须在最外层；而 `init_weights` 放在最后，是因为分片后的参数要用与单机一致的方式初始化再切开（u3-l6 讲过的 `distribute_like` 机制）。
192

257	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
258	
259	**练习 1**：如果把 FSDP 包装放在 `optim.build()` 之后会发生什么？
260	
261	<details>
262	<summary>参考答案</summary>
263	
264	优化器会持有**未分片**的完整参数引用。随后 FSDP 把参数替换为 DTensor 分片，优化器手里的引用与模型实际参数脱钩：轻则更新作用在错误的对象上，重则状态字典对不上导致 checkpoint 无法恢复。所以顺序必须是「并行化 → 建优化器」，源码里两步前后相接（[transformer/train_module.py:L198-L212](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L198-L212) 与 [L235-L242](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L235-L242)）。
265	</details>
266	
267	**练习 2**：`TransformerTrainModuleConfig.build()` 是怎么决定构建 `TransformerTrainModule` 还是 `TransformerPipelineTrainModule` 的？这种「一个配置类、多个实现类」的设计有什么好处？
268	
269	<details>
270	<summary>参考答案</summary>
271	
272	只看 `pp_config` 是否为 `None`（[transformer/config.py:L456-L469](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/config.py#L456-L469)）。好处：用户视角只有一个配置类、一套 YAML 字段，命令行加一个 `--train_module.pp_config.degree=4` 就能切换到流水线实现，实验配置无需重写；实现视角则允许流水线版本有完全不同的 `train_batch` 内部结构而不污染普通版本。
273	</details>
274	
275	**练习 3**：`parallelize_model` 里为什么 `init_weights` 必须放在所有并行包装之后？
276	
277	<details>
278	<summary>参考答案</summary>
279	
280	因为初始化要在**最终参数形态**上进行，且分片环境下的随机数消耗必须与单机一致（u3-l6：`init_seed` 走专属 `torch.Generator`，流水线下按 `pp_rank + part_idx × pp_size` 偏移；`_apply_init` + `distribute_like` 保证 DTensor 分片与单机初始化一致）。若先初始化再并行化，随机数消耗顺序和分片内容都会变，同一 seed 不再可复现。
281	</details>
282	
283	### 4.3 一次训练步的完整代码路径：train_batch → optim_step → zero_grads
284	
285	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
286	
287	这是本讲的核心。`TransformerTrainModule` 的三个方法合起来构成一步训练，我们逐段读源码。先建立直觉：
288	
289	- **`train_batch`**：拿一个 batch（字典，至少含 `input_ids`），切 成若干 micro-batch，对每个 micro-batch 做前向算 loss 再反向；梯度自然累加在 `param.grad` 上。**它不更新参数**。
290	- **`optim_step`**：先（可选）裁剪梯度，再（可选）按调度器调整学习率，最后 `optim.step()` 更新参数。
291	- **`zero_grads`**：清空梯度，为下一个 step 做准备。
292	
293	梯度累积的正确性依赖一个关键的归一化决定：**每个 micro-batch 的 loss 用 `sum` 归约，再除以整个 batch 的有效 token 数**。这就是源码里的 `loss_reduction="sum"` + `loss_div_factor=batch_num_tokens_for_loss` 组合。
294	
295	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
296	
297	`train_batch` 的执行序列：
298	
299	```text
300	train_batch(batch):
301	  ① _set_model_mode("train")                    # 幂等地切 train 模式
302	  ② batch 里没有 labels? → get_labels()          # input_ids 左移一位，末位 pad 成 -100
303	  ③ 数出有效 token 数 N（labels != -100 的个数）
304	  ④ 记录 masked labels 比例指标
305	  ⑤ split_batch(batch, rank_microbatch_size // seq_len)   # 按实例数切 micro-batch
306	  ⑥ for 每个 micro-batch:
307	       _train_microbatch_context(i, n)           # 只在最后一个 micro-batch 开梯度同步
308	       _prepare_batch() → input_ids, labels, 其余 kwargs
309	       model_forward(..., loss_reduction="sum",
310	                     loss_div_factor=N)           # 返回 (logits, loss, ce_loss, z_loss)
311	       ce_batch_loss += ce_loss.detach()          # 累计用于记录的 loss
312	       loss.backward()                            # 梯度累加到 .grad
313	  ⑦ model.post_batch()                           # 模型侧的 batch 后处理钩子
314	  ⑧ 记录 CE loss / Z loss / 辅助指标（经 record_* 转交 Trainer）
315	```
316	
317	**为什么 `sum ÷ N` 而不是每个 micro-batch 各自取 `mean`？** 设整批共 \( N \) 个有效 token 的损失为 \( \ell_1, \dots, \ell_N \)，我们想要的梯度是
318	
319	\[
320	\nabla_\theta \left( \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} \ell_i \right) = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} \nabla_\theta \ell_i .
321	\]
322	
323	把 batch 切成若干 micro-batch 后，`backward()` 在 `.grad` 上做的是**加法**。若每个 micro-batch 反传 \(\sum_{i \in B_k} \ell_i / N\)（即 `sum` 归约再除以全局 \( N \)），累加结果恰好是上式——**与 micro-batch 怎么划分无关**。反之若每个 micro-batch 用自己的 \(\frac{1}{|B_k|}\sum_{i \in B_k} \ell_i\)（各自 `mean`），小 micro-batch 的每个 token 会被等权放大，划分方式不同得到的梯度就不同，损失曲线还会随 batch 内样本数波动（padding 多的 batch 尤其明显）。`BasicTrainModule` 里的同款源码注释（[train_module.py:L349-L351](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/train_module.py#L349-L351)）明确点明了这一点。
324	
325	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
326	
327	**labels 从哪来**：
328	
329	- [data/utils.py:L613-L628](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/data/utils.py#L613-L628)：`get_labels()`——labels 就是 input_ids **左移一位**（预测下一个 token），首位被丢弃、末位 pad 成 `label_ignore_index`（默认 -100）；若 batch 带 `label_mask` / `attention_mask` / `instance_mask`，对应位置也填成 -100（这些 token 不计损失，u4-l1 讲过 label_mask 的用途）。
330	- [transformer/train_module.py:L419-L427](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L419-L427)：`train_batch` 开头——batch 没有 `labels` 键就现场生成；随后 `(batch["labels"] != self.label_ignore_index).sum()` 得到本 batch 的有效 token 数 `batch_num_tokens_for_loss`，即公式里的 \( N \)。
331	
332	**切 micro-batch**：
333	
334	- [data/utils.py:L43-L57](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/data/utils.py#L43-L57)：`split_batch(batch, num_microbatch_instances)` 沿第 0 维把张量切成若干份。
335	- [transformer/train_module.py:L457-L463](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L457-L463)：每个 micro-batch 的 token 预算是 `rank_microbatch_size`，序列长度是 `seq_len`，所以一份装 `rank_microbatch_size // seq_len` 条实例。若 `rank_microbatch_size < seq_len` 直接报错（一个 micro-batch 至少一条完整序列）。
336	
337	**micro-batch 循环主体**：
338	
339	- [transformer/train_module.py:L466-L491](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L466-L491)：循环体。`_prepare_batch`（[L712-L719](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L712-L719)）把 `input_ids`/`labels` 从字典里 pop 出来，**剩下的键（如 `label_mask`、`doc_lens`）作为 model_kwargs 原样传给模型**。前向调用（[L471-L480](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L471-L480)）带上了 `loss_reduction="sum"` 与 `loss_div_factor=batch_num_tokens_for_loss`——归一化发生在模型内部的 LMHead（u3-l4：loss 计算被收进 LMHead，支持 fused 实现免物化 logits）。返回的四元组解包自 `LMOutputWithLoss`（NamedTuple：`logits/loss/ce_loss/z_loss`，见 [lm_head.py:L192-L200](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/nn/lm_head.py#L192-L200)）：`loss` 是拿来 backward 的（= ce_loss + z_loss_multiplier × z_loss），`ce_loss`/`z_loss` 仅用于记录。`ce_batch_loss += ce_loss.detach()`（[L483](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L483)）只累计** detached** 的数值避免保留整张计算图；`loss.backward()` 在 [L491](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L491)。
340	
341	**梯度同步的开关——梯度累积的另一半**：
342	
343	- [transformer/train_module.py:L636-L655](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L636-L655)：`_train_microbatch_context` 是一个上下文管理器，按模型包装类型三选一：**DDP** 用 `model.no_sync()` 关掉中间 micro-batch 的梯度 all-reduce（[L650-L653](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L650-L653)）；**FSDP** 用 `set_is_last_backward(is_last_mb)`（[L642-L646](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L642-L646)）；**HSDP** 额外用 `set_requires_all_reduce(is_last_mb)` 把 all-reduce 推迟到最后的 micro-batch（[L648-L649](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L648-L649)）。三者目的一致：**只在最后一个 micro-batch 触发跨 rank 梯度同步**——既然各 micro-batch 的梯度本地累加即可，中间就同步纯属浪费通信。没有这层开关，DDP 每个 micro-batch 都会 all-reduce 一次，通信次数翻倍。
344	
345	**收尾与指标**：
346	
347	- [transformer/train_module.py:L495-L499](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L495-L499)：`model.post_batch()`（基类默认空操作，某些实现有副作用）与 `dry_run` 分支（重置辅助指标后直接返回，不记录任何东西）。
348	- [transformer/train_module.py:L502-L512](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L502-L512)：**SkipStepOptimizer 特例**——若优化器是带 loss spike 检测的包装器（u5-l3），必须**立刻**跨 rank all-reduce loss（不能等 Trainer 攒批归约），因为它要在 `optim_step` 里用 `latest_loss` 判断是否跳步；归约时还要绕开除以 world size 的常规路径（先乘再除 `_reduce_divide_factor` 的写法是为了兼容 bf16 等低精度下的数值稳定性）。普通优化器则走 `record_ce_loss(ce_batch_loss, ReduceType.mean)` 交给 Trainer 延迟归约。
349	- [transformer/train_module.py:L529-L537](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L529-L537)：`model.compute_auxiliary_metrics(reset=True)` 取出模型累积的辅助指标（基类返回空字典，MoE 的负载均衡损失走这条路，u3-l5）。
350	
351	**`optim_step` 三段式**：
352	
353	- [transformer/train_module.py:L583-L606](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L583-L606)：第一段**裁剪**（`max_grad_norm` 非 `None` 时）调 `_clip_grad_norm`，并把（已归约的）梯度范数记为指标；若是 `SkipStepOptimizer`，把 `latest_grad_norm` 喂给它（呼应 u5-l3 的时序契约：`latest_loss`/`latest_grad_norm` 必须先于 `step()` 就位）。第二段**调学习率**（[L596-L599](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L596-L599)）：对每个参数组调 `scheduler.set_lr(group, self.trainer)`——注意调度器要拿 trainer 读当前 step（u5-l2）。第三段 `optim.step()`（[L602](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L602)），随后 `model.post_optim_step()`（[L606](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L606)，float8 训练用它预计算动态 scale）。
354	- [transformer/train_module.py:L683-L710](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L683-L710)：`_clip_grad_norm` 的两个分支——FSDP 模型直接用包装器自带的 `clip_grad_norm_`（它知道分片怎么归约）；否则手工算总范数，**关键在 [L704-L707](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L704-L707)**：若 `total_norm` 是 DTensor（开了 TP/CP 等非流水线并行时），必须 `full_tensor()` 把各 rank 的局部范数归约成全局值，否则每个 rank 会按自己那份范数裁剪，裁出来的模型各 rank 不一致。
355	- [transformer/train_module.py:L608-L610](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L608-L610)：`zero_grads` 一行——`optim.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)`（置 `None` 而非清零可以省一次稠密写、并让下次反向重新分配稀疏梯度）。
356	
357	**前向的统一入口**：
358	
359	- [transformer/train_module.py:L612-L619](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L612-L619)：`model_forward` 把 `self.model(input_ids, labels=labels, **kwargs)` 包进 `_model_forward_context`——后者只在设置了 `autocast_precision` 时套一层 `torch.autocast`（AMP 混合精度）。`train_batch` 与 `eval_batch` 都走这个入口。
360	- [transformer/train_module.py:L721-L729](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L721-L729)：`_set_model_mode` 用一个成员变量记住当前模式，**只在变化时**调 `model.train()`/`model.eval()`——避免每个 batch 重复切换的开销与副作用。
361	
362	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
363	
364	**实践目标**：不启动完整 `Trainer`，手动驱动一个 `TransformerTrainModule` 走完「前向反向 → 优化器步进 → 清梯度」，打印 loss、梯度与优化器状态，验证你理解的调用链与源码一致。
365	
366	关键障碍与解法：`train_batch` 末尾会调 `record_metric` → `self.trainer.record_metric(...)`，而 `self.trainer` 在未挂载时抛 `RuntimeError`。解法是仿照库内测试的思路注入一个**stub trainer**（鸭子类型：只要有 `record_metric` 与 `record_ce_loss` 两个方法即可）。
367	
368	1. **操作步骤**：将以下示例代码保存为 `manual_train_step.py`（示例代码，非项目原有文件）：
369	
370	   ```python
371	   # 示例代码：manual_train_step.py —— 手动驱动 TransformerTrainModule 走一步训练
372	   import torch
373	   from olmo_core.nn.feed_forward import FeedForwardConfig
374	   from olmo_core.nn.transformer import TransformerConfig
375	   from olmo_core.optim import AdamWConfig
376	   from olmo_core.train.train_module.transformer import TransformerTrainModuleConfig
377	
378	   SEQ_LEN = 128
379	
380	   class StubTrainer:
381	       """只实现 train_batch/optim_step 会用到的那两个上报方法。"""
382	       def __init__(self):
383	           self.metrics, self.ce_losses = [], []
384	       def record_metric(self, name, value, reduce_type=None, namespace=None, merge_strategy=None):
385	           self.metrics.append((namespace or "", name))
386	       def record_ce_loss(self, value, reduce_type=None):
387	           self.ce_losses.append(float(value))
388	
389	   torch.manual_seed(0)
390	   model_cfg = TransformerConfig.llama_like(
391	       d_model=64, vocab_size=128, n_layers=2, n_heads=2,
392	       feed_forward=FeedForwardConfig(hidden_size=128, bias=False),
393	   )
394	   model = model_cfg.build(init_device="cpu")
395	
396	   tm_cfg = TransformerTrainModuleConfig(   # 不设 dp_config：单进程、非分布式
397	       rank_microbatch_size=SEQ_LEN,         # = 序列长度 → 每个 micro-batch 恰好 1 条实例
398	       max_sequence_length=SEQ_LEN,
399	       optim=AdamWConfig(lr=1e-3),
400	   )
401	   tm = tm_cfg.build(model, device=torch.device("cpu"))
402	   tm._trainer = StubTrainer()               # 注入 stub，让 record_* 有处可去
403	
404	   # ① 构造随机 batch：2 条样本 × 128 token；labels 留空，让 train_batch 自己生成
405	   batch = {"input_ids": torch.randint(0, 128, (2, SEQ_LEN))}
406	
407	   # ② 前向 + 反向（对应 Trainer 里的 train_batch 调用）
408	   tm.train_batch(batch)
409	   print("CE loss:", tm._trainer.ce_losses[-1])
410	   grads = [p.grad for p in tm.model.parameters() if p.grad is not None]
411	   print("有梯度的参数个数:", len(grads))
412	   print("梯度总范数:", torch.sqrt(sum(g.float().pow(2).sum() for g in grads)).item())
413	
414	   # ③ 优化器步进（对应 optim_step），检查 AdamW 状态是否生成
415	   tm.optim_step()
416	   some_param = next(iter(tm.optim.state))
417	   print("优化器状态键:", sorted(tm.optim.state[some_param].keys()))
418	
419	   # ④ 清梯度（对应 zero_grads），验证 .grad 变回 None
420	   tm.zero_grads()
421	   print("清梯度后非空 .grad 个数:",
422	         sum(p.grad is not None for p in tm.model.parameters()))
423	   ```
424	
425	   运行：`python manual_train_step.py`（CPU 即可，无需 GPU / torchrun）。
426	
427	2. **需要观察的现象**：四段输出——CE loss 数值；有梯度的参数个数；AdamW 状态键列表；清梯度后的非空梯度计数。
428	3. **预期结果**：
429	   - CE loss 是有限正数，量级在随机初始化模型的 \(\ln 128 \approx 4.85\) 附近；
430	   - 全部（非共享导致的重复计入除外）参数都拿到梯度；
431	   - `optim.step()` 之后状态里出现 `['exp_avg', 'exp_avg_sq', 'step']` 三个键（AdamW 的一阶/二阶动量与步数）；
432	   - `zero_grads()` 后非空 `.grad` 计数为 0（`set_to_none=True` 的效果）。
433	   - 数值细节属「待本地验证」，但四类行为本身由源码直接保证。
434	4. **对照源码**：数一数 [transformer/train_module.py:L466-L491](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L466-L491) 的循环次数——batch 有 2 条实例、`rank_microbatch_size // seq_len = 1`，所以循环执行 **2 次**（即 2 步梯度累积）。可以在自己的脚本里包一层打印来验证，不要修改仓库源码。
435	
436	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
437	
438	**练习 1**：把 4.3.4 脚本里的 `rank_microbatch_size` 改成 `2 * SEQ_LEN`（其余不变、seed 相同）重建后再跑一次 `train_batch`，梯度总范数会怎么变？
439	
440	<details>
441	<summary>参考答案</summary>
442	
443	不变（浮点误差内）。因为此时整个 batch 就是**一个** micro-batch，循环只执行 1 次；而 `sum ÷ N` 的归一化保证梯度只依赖整批 token，与 micro-batch 划分无关（4.3.2 的公式）。这正是「梯度累积等价于大 batch」的可验证形式。tiny 差异来自浮点求和顺序，属正常现象。
444	</details>
445	
446	**练习 2**：为什么 `SkipStepOptimizer` 用户走的是「立刻 all-reduce loss」的特例分支，而不是和普通优化器一样把 loss 交给 Trainer 延迟归约？
447	
448	<details>
449	<summary>参考答案</summary>
450	
451	`SkipStepOptimizer` 要在紧随其后的 `optim_step()` 里用滑动窗口的「均值 + kσ」判据检测 loss spike（u5-l3），等不得 Trainer 按 `metrics_collect_interval` 攒批归约。且各 rank 必须基于**同一个** loss 值做跳步决策，否则有的 rank 跳、有的不跳，模型参数会分叉。所以 [transformer/train_module.py:L502-L510](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L502-L510) 在 `train_batch` 末尾就同步 all-reduce，并把结果写进 `self.optim.latest_loss`。
452	</details>
453	
454	**练习 3**：`_clip_grad_norm` 里 `isinstance(total_norm, DTensor)` 分支删掉会有什么后果？
455	
456	<details>
457	<summary>参考答案</summary>
458	
459	开了 TP/CP 等并行后，每个 rank 算出的 `total_norm` 只是**本 rank 分片**的局部范数。没有 `full_tensor()` 归约，各 rank 会按不同的局部范数执行裁剪缩放，导致同一参数在不同 rank 上更新不一致，模型悄悄发散。这正是张量并行训练最隐蔽的一类 bug（u7-l2 会再次遇到「跨 rank 归约」这个主题）。
460	</details>
461	
462	## 5. 综合实践
463	
464	**任务：把 4.3.4 的单步脚本扩展成「微型训练循环 + 梯度累积等价性 + 单卡 DDP」三连实验。**
465	
466	1. **微型循环**：在 4.3.4 脚本外再套一个 10 步的循环（每步换一批新的随机 `input_ids`，`seed` 固定），记录每步 CE loss，画出（或打印出）loss 随 step 的下降。这一步你在手写一个去掉所有回调、checkpoint、评估的「裸 Trainer」，写完后对照 [trainer.py:L1691-L1734](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/trainer.py#L1691-L1734) 的 `_fit_epoch`，逐行找出你写的循环里缺了哪些环节（答案应包括：step 簿记、token 计数、pre_step / pre_optim_step / post_train_batch / post_step 回调、should_skip、停训检查）。
467	2. **梯度累积等价性**：分别用 `rank_microbatch_size = SEQ_LEN` 与 `rank_microbatch_size = 2 * SEQ_LEN` 各跑一次 `train_batch`（相同 batch、相同 seed 重建模型），比较两者的梯度总范数与 10 步后的 loss 轨迹是否一致（浮点误差内），用实验印证 4.3.2 的数学。
468	3. **真正的单卡 DP（选做，需 torchrun）**：给 config 加 `dp_config=TransformerDataParallelConfig(name=DataParallelType.ddp)`，并改用 `torchrun --nproc-per-node=1 manual_train_step.py` 启动（world size 为 1 的 DDP 是合法配置）。观察日志依次出现 `Data parallel world size = 1`（[transformer/train_module.py:L178](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/train_module.py#L178)）与 `Applied DDP to the model...`（[common.py:L143](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/common.py#L143)）。此变体依赖本地分布式后端可用性，结果「待本地验证」。
469	
470	完成标志：你能不看讲义，向别人画出从 `TransformerTrainModuleConfig.build()` 到一次参数更新之间的完整框图（构建四步 + 训练步三段），并指出梯度同步、loss 归一化、学习率调整分别发生在哪个环节。
471	
472	## 6. 本讲小结
473	
474	- `TrainModule` 是 `Trainer` 与「怎么训练」之间的合同：`train_batch`/`eval_batch`/`optim_step`/`zero_grads` 四个计算方法 + state_dict 族 + 评估规格与 FLOPs 统计；`Trainer` 在 [trainer.py:L1711-L1724](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/trainer.py#L1711-L1724) 按固定节奏调用它们，指标则经 `record_metric`/`record_ce_loss` 从 train module 回流。
475	- DP/TP/CP/EP/PP/AC 六套并行配置挂在 `TransformerTrainModuleConfig` 上，因为并行化必须夹在「模型建好后、优化器建好前」：它改变参数的物理形态（DTensor 分片、FSDP 包装）、依赖运行时 world size，且产出的数据并行进程组要交还 Trainer 切数据。
476	- 构建链路四步：校验尺寸 → `build_world_mesh` → `parallelize_model`（固定顺序 PP→FP8→CP→TP→EP→激活检查点→compile→DP，**最后** `init_weights`）→ `optim.build`；`pp_config` 非 None 时 `build()` 自动分发出 `TransformerPipelineTrainModule`；`eval_only=True` 跳过优化器。
477	- `train_batch` 骨架：生成 labels（input_ids 左移、-100 pad）→ 数出全局有效 token 数 \( N \) → 按 token 预算切 micro-batch → 逐个「前向（`sum` 损失 ÷ \( N \)）→ backward」→ 记录指标；`sum + loss_div_factor=N` 保证梯度与 micro-batch 划分无关。
478	- 梯度同步开关在 `_train_microbatch_context`：DDP 用 `no_sync()`、FSDP 用 `set_is_last_backward`、HSDP 用 `set_requires_all_reduce`，都只让**最后一个** micro-batch 触发跨 rank 同步。
479	- `optim_step` 三段式：裁剪（DTensor 范数必须 `full_tensor()` 归约）→ 逐参数组 `scheduler.set_lr` → `optim.step()` + `post_optim_step()`；`SkipStepOptimizer` 用户额外要求 loss 在 `train_batch` 末尾就被即时 all-reduce 进 `latest_loss`。
480	
481	## 7. 下一步学习建议
482	
483	- **u6-l3（回调系统）**：本讲反复看到 `pre_optim_step`、`post_train_batch` 等钩子插在 train_module 调用之间，下一讲系统讲 `Callback` 体系，并动手写一个自定义回调挂进 `TrainerConfig`。
484	- **u7-l1（数据并行）**：本讲只说清了 FSDP/DDP 包装「在哪里、由谁套上」；分片策略、梯度归约细节与 HSDP 的取舍留给下一单元展开。
485	- **u7-l2（TP/PP/CP/EP）**：`pp_config` 分发出的 `TransformerPipelineTrainModule` 与 `parallelize_model` 里 CP/TP/EP 各步的内部机制是多维并行的重头戏。
486	- **延伸阅读**：[src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/objective.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/objective.py)（`train_batch_with_loss` 的自定义训练目标接口）与 [ddp_train_module.py](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/transformer/ddp_train_module.py)（融合 MoE 优化器的 `OLMoDDPTrainModule`）是本讲两个「兄弟实现」，对照阅读能加深对抽象的理解；`BasicTrainModule`（[train_module.py:L245-L413](https://github.com/allenai/OLMo-core/blob/704625ad94a7c8bc93f9bea7a0b865b9a0c3d44e/src/olmo_core/train/train_module/train_module.py#L245-L413)）则是无并行、无调度版本的最好参照。

51	def _global_batch(zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance: bool = False) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
52	    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
53	    input_ids = torch.randint(0, VOCAB_SIZE, (NUM_INSTANCES, SEQ_LEN), generator=generator)
54	    labels = torch.full_like(input_ids, IGNORE_INDEX)
55	    labels[:, :-1] = input_ids[:, 1:]
56	    # Very unequal numbers of loss tokens per instance (as with SFT label masking):
57	    # instances 0, 1, 2, 3 have 7, 6, 1 and 2 loss tokens.
58	    labels[1, :1] = IGNORE_INDEX
59	    labels[2, :6] = IGNORE_INDEX
60	    labels[3, :5] = IGNORE_INDEX
61	    if zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance:
62	        # With 4 DP ranks, the last rank then has no loss tokens at all.
63	        labels[3, :] = IGNORE_INDEX
64	    return {"input_ids": input_ids, "labels": labels}

67	def _full_grads(model: torch.nn.Module) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
68	    grads = {}
69	    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
70	        assert param.grad is not None, name
71	        grad = param.grad
72	        grads[name] = grad.full_tensor() if isinstance(grad, DTensor) else grad
73	    return grads

96	    # with the loss being the mean over all loss tokens in the global batch.
97	    state_dict = {

from typing import Dict, List, Optional

import pytest
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.nn.functional as F
from torch.distributed.tensor import DTensor

from olmo_core.distributed.parallel import DataParallelType
from olmo_core.nn.attention import AttentionBackendName
from olmo_core.nn.feed_forward import FeedForwardConfig
from olmo_core.nn.transformer import TransformerConfig
from olmo_core.optim import AdamWConfig
from olmo_core.testing import run_distributed_test
from olmo_core.train.train_module.transformer import (
    TransformerDataParallelConfig,
    TransformerTrainModuleConfig,
)

VOCAB_SIZE = 32
SEQ_LEN = 8
NUM_INSTANCES = 4
IGNORE_INDEX = -100


class _StubTrainer:
    """Minimal stand-in: ``train_batch`` only reaches the trainer to record metrics."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.ce_losses: List[torch.Tensor] = []

    def record_metric(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
        del args, kwargs

    def record_ce_loss(self, value, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
        del args, kwargs
        self.ce_losses.append(value.detach().clone())


def _model_config() -> TransformerConfig:
    return TransformerConfig.llama_like(
        d_model=16,
        vocab_size=VOCAB_SIZE,
        n_layers=1,
        n_heads=2,
        feed_forward=FeedForwardConfig(hidden_size=32, bias=False),
        attn_backend=AttentionBackendName.torch,
    )


def _global_batch(zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance: bool = False) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
    input_ids = torch.randint(0, VOCAB_SIZE, (NUM_INSTANCES, SEQ_LEN), generator=generator)
    labels = torch.full_like(input_ids, IGNORE_INDEX)
    labels[:, :-1] = input_ids[:, 1:]
    # Very unequal numbers of loss tokens per instance (as with SFT label masking):
    # instances 0, 1, 2, 3 have 7, 6, 1 and 2 loss tokens.
    labels[1, :1] = IGNORE_INDEX
    labels[2, :6] = IGNORE_INDEX
    labels[3, :5] = IGNORE_INDEX
    if zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance:
        # With 4 DP ranks, the last rank then has no loss tokens at all.
        labels[3, :] = IGNORE_INDEX
    return {"input_ids": input_ids, "labels": labels}


def _full_grads(model: torch.nn.Module) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
    grads = {}
    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        assert param.grad is not None, name
        grad = param.grad
        grads[name] = grad.full_tensor() if isinstance(grad, DTensor) else grad
    return grads


def _run_global_token_loss_normalization(
    dp_type: DataParallelType,
    instances_per_microbatch: int,
    zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance: bool = False,
    shard_degree: Optional[int] = None,
):
    dp_ws = dist.get_world_size()
    rank = dist.get_rank()
    device = torch.device("cpu")

    module = TransformerTrainModuleConfig(
        rank_microbatch_size=instances_per_microbatch * SEQ_LEN,
        max_sequence_length=SEQ_LEN,
        optim=AdamWConfig(),
        dp_config=TransformerDataParallelConfig(name=dp_type, shard_degree=shard_degree),
        label_ignore_index=IGNORE_INDEX,
    ).build(_model_config().build(init_device="cpu"), device=device)
    module._trainer = _StubTrainer()  # type: ignore[assignment]

    # Reference: a non-distributed copy of the same model trained on the whole global batch,
    # with the loss being the mean over all loss tokens in the global batch.
    state_dict = {
        k: v.full_tensor() if isinstance(v, DTensor) else v
        for k, v in module.model.state_dict().items()
    }
    ref_model = _model_config().build(init_device="cpu")
    ref_model.load_state_dict(state_dict)
    global_batch = _global_batch(zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance)
    ref_logits = ref_model(global_batch["input_ids"])
    assert isinstance(ref_logits, torch.Tensor)
    ref_loss = F.cross_entropy(
        ref_logits.view(-1, VOCAB_SIZE),
        global_batch["labels"].view(-1),
        ignore_index=IGNORE_INDEX,
    )
    ref_loss.backward()
    ref_grads = _full_grads(ref_model)

    # Each DP rank gets a contiguous slice of the global batch.
    n = NUM_INSTANCES // dp_ws
    local_batch = {k: v[rank * n : (rank + 1) * n].clone() for k, v in global_batch.items()}
    module.zero_grads()
    module.train_batch(local_batch)

    grads = _full_grads(module.model)
    assert grads.keys() == ref_grads.keys()
    for name, grad in grads.items():
        torch.testing.assert_close(grad, ref_grads[name], msg=lambda m: f"{name}: {m}")

    # The logged CE loss (averaged over ranks by the trainer) should be the global token mean.
    ce_loss = module.trainer.ce_losses[-1]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    dist.all_reduce(ce_loss)
    torch.testing.assert_close(ce_loss / dp_ws, ref_loss.detach())


@pytest.mark.parametrize("dp_type", [DataParallelType.fsdp, DataParallelType.ddp])
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "instances_per_microbatch", [pytest.param(1, id="grad-accum"), pytest.param(2, id="no-accum")]
)
def test_train_batch_normalizes_loss_by_global_token_count(
    dp_type: DataParallelType, instances_per_microbatch: int
):
    run_distributed_test(
        _run_global_token_loss_normalization,
        backend="gloo",
        start_method="spawn",
        func_args=(dp_type, instances_per_microbatch),
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "dp_type, shard_degree",
    [
        pytest.param(DataParallelType.fsdp, None, id="fsdp"),
        pytest.param(DataParallelType.ddp, None, id="ddp"),
        pytest.param(DataParallelType.hsdp, 2, id="hsdp-2x2"),
    ],
)
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance",
    [pytest.param(False, id="uneven"), pytest.param(True, id="rank-with-no-loss-tokens")],
)
def test_train_batch_normalizes_loss_by_global_token_count_4_ranks(
    dp_type: DataParallelType, shard_degree: Optional[int], zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance: bool
):
    run_distributed_test(
        _run_global_token_loss_normalization,
        world_size=4,
        backend="gloo",
        start_method="spawn",
        func_args=(dp_type, 1, zero_loss_tokens_on_last_instance, shard_degree),
    )

"""Accumulate a caller-normalized objective with Core gradient synchronization.

        Leave ``reset_auxiliary_metrics=False`` to collect and manage model auxiliary
        metrics yourself. Set it to True to clear them before training and on exit,
        including failure, without changing auxiliary losses or gradients.
        """
        return objective_utils.train_batch_with_loss(
            self,
            micro_batches,
            objective,
            context_factory,
            reset_auxiliary_metrics=reset_auxiliary_metrics,
        )

    def train_batch(self, batch: Dict[str, Any], dry_run: bool = False):
        # Set model to train mode if it isn't already.
        self._set_model_mode("train")

        # Generate labels.
        if "labels" not in batch:
            batch["labels"] = get_labels(batch, label_ignore_index=self.label_ignore_index)

        # Calculate how many tokens will be used in the loss.
        batch_num_tokens = batch["labels"].numel()
        batch_num_tokens_per_instance = batch["labels"].shape[1]
        batch_num_tokens_for_loss = move_to_device(
            (batch["labels"] != self.label_ignore_index).sum(), self.device
        )

        # Record percentage of masked labels.
        self.record_metric(
            "train/masked labels (%)",  # just a proportion, not a percentage
            (batch_num_tokens - batch_num_tokens_for_loss) / batch_num_tokens,
            ReduceType.mean,
        )

        # Record percentage of masked instances.
        if (instance_mask := batch.get("instance_mask")) is not None:
            self.record_metric(
                "train/masked instances (%)",  # just a proportion, not a percentage
                (~instance_mask).float().mean(),
                ReduceType.mean,
            )

            # WARN: When we mask out instances with the instance filter, we count those tokens
            # for the loss anyways. They will count as tokens with a zero loss. This means we
            # get an artificially *low* loss for these batches. But it is really hard (and slow)
            # to do this properly in a distributed setup. We add back in the full number of tokens
            # for the loss so that each rank contributes to the loss calculation fairly.
            batch_num_tokens_for_loss += (~instance_mask).sum() * batch_num_tokens_per_instance

        # Normalize by the global number of loss tokens rather than the local one, so that the
        # objective is the mean over all loss tokens in the global batch regardless of how they're
        # distributed across DP ranks. Since gradients get averaged over DP ranks, we divide the
        # global count by the DP world size. NOTE: CP/TP ranks see the same (unsharded) labels here,
        # so they're not part of the DP process group sum and the LM head already accounts for them.
        if is_distributed() and self.dp_config is not None:
            dist.all_reduce(batch_num_tokens_for_loss, group=self.dp_process_group)
            batch_num_tokens_for_loss = batch_num_tokens_for_loss.clamp_min(1) / get_world_size(
                self.dp_process_group
            )
        else:
            batch_num_tokens_for_loss = batch_num_tokens_for_loss.clamp_min(1)

        # Batch losses to record.
        ce_batch_loss = move_to_device(torch.tensor(0.0), self.device)
        z_batch_loss: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
        if self.z_loss_multiplier is not None:
            z_batch_loss = move_to_device(torch.tensor(0.0), self.device)

        # Split into micro-batches.
        if self.rank_microbatch_size < (seq_len := batch["input_ids"].shape[1]):
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Microbatch size ({self.rank_microbatch_size}) is too small relative to sequence length ({seq_len})"
            )
        micro_batches = split_batch(batch, self.rank_microbatch_size // seq_len)
        num_micro_batches = len(micro_batches)

        # Train one micro-batch at a time.
        for micro_batch_idx, micro_batch in enumerate(micro_batches):
            with self._train_microbatch_context(micro_batch_idx, num_micro_batches):
                input_ids, labels, model_kwargs = self._prepare_batch(micro_batch)

                # Run forward pass, get losses.
                _, loss, ce_loss, z_loss = self.model_forward(
                    input_ids,
                    labels=labels,
                    ignore_index=self.label_ignore_index,
                    loss_reduction="sum",
                    z_loss_multiplier=self.z_loss_multiplier,
                    loss_div_factor=batch_num_tokens_for_loss,
                    return_logits=False,
                    **model_kwargs,
                )

                # Update total batch CE and Z loss.
                ce_batch_loss += get_local_tensor(ce_loss.detach())
                del ce_loss
                if z_batch_loss is not None:
                    assert z_loss is not None
                    z_batch_loss += get_local_tensor(z_loss.detach())
                    del z_loss

                # Run backward pass.
                loss.backward()

        del batch  # In case this helps with memory utilization.

        self.model.post_batch(dry_run=dry_run)

        if dry_run:
            self.model.reset_auxiliary_metrics()
            return

        # Record loss metrics.
        if isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer):
            # Need to reduce the loss right away for the SkipStepOptimizer.
            if is_distributed():
                ce_batch_loss.div_(self._reduce_divide_factor)
                dist.all_reduce(ce_batch_loss)
                ce_batch_loss.div_(self.world_size)
                ce_batch_loss.mul_(self._reduce_divide_factor)
            self.record_ce_loss(ce_batch_loss)
            self.optim.latest_loss = ce_batch_loss
        else:
            self.record_ce_loss(ce_batch_loss, ReduceType.mean)
        if z_batch_loss is not None:
            assert self.z_loss_multiplier is not None
            self.record_metric(
                "Z loss",
                z_batch_loss,
                ReduceType.mean,
                namespace="train",
            )
            self.record_metric(
                "Z loss unscaled",
                z_batch_loss / self.z_loss_multiplier,
                ReduceType.mean,
                namespace="train",
            )

        # And additional metrics.
        for metric_name, (metric_val, reduction) in self.model.compute_auxiliary_metrics(
            reset=True
        ).items():
            self.record_metric(
                metric_name,
                metric_val,
                reduction,
                namespace="train",
            )

    def eval_batch(
        self, batch: Dict[str, Any], labels: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> Union[torch.Tensor, LMOutputWithLoss]:
        # CP and TP are supported for PPL evals (LMEvaluator) since they only need per-token
        # CE loss. Downstream evals that require full logits will fail naturally if attempted
        # with CP or TP.

        input_ids, labels, model_kwargs = self._prepare_batch(batch, labels)

        # When using CP/TP, shard the label_mask along the sequence dimension to match the
        # sharded ce_loss output shape. CP shards first (S -> S/CP), then TP shards further
        # (S/CP -> S/(CP*TP)).
        if self.cp_enabled and "label_mask" in model_kwargs:
            assert self.model._cp_load_balancer is not None
            (label_mask,) = self.model._cp_load_balancer.batch_shard(
                inputs=[model_kwargs["label_mask"]],
                seq_dims=[1],
                pad_values=[0],
            )
            model_kwargs["label_mask"] = label_mask.to(torch.bool)

        if self.tp_enabled and "label_mask" in model_kwargs:
            tp_mesh = self.model._tp_mesh
            assert tp_mesh is not None
            chunks = model_kwargs["label_mask"].chunk(tp_mesh.size(), dim=1)
            model_kwargs["label_mask"] = chunks[tp_mesh.get_local_rank()]

        self._set_model_mode("eval")

        with self._eval_batch_context():
            output = self.model_forward(
                input_ids,
                labels=labels,
                ignore_index=self.label_ignore_index,
                loss_reduction="none",
                return_logits=False if (self.cp_enabled or self.tp_enabled) else None,
                **model_kwargs,
            )

        if self.tp_enabled and isinstance(output, LMOutputWithLoss):
            output = output._replace(ce_loss=get_local_tensor(output.ce_loss))

        return output

    def optim_step(self):
        assert self.optim is not None, "optim_step() is not available in eval_only mode"
        # Maybe clip gradients.
        if self.max_grad_norm is not None:
            grad_norm = self._clip_grad_norm(self.max_grad_norm)
            # NOTE: grad norm is already reduced over ranks, so we set `reduce_type` to `None`.
            self.trainer.record_metric(
                "total grad norm", grad_norm, reduce_type=None, namespace="optim"
            )
            if isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer):
                self.optim.latest_grad_norm = grad_norm

        # Maybe adjust learning rate.
        if self.scheduler is not None:
            for group_idx, group in enumerate(self.optim.param_groups):
                new_lr = self.scheduler.set_lr(group, self.trainer)
                self.trainer.record_metric(f"LR (group {group_idx})", new_lr, namespace="optim")

        # Step optimizer.
        self.optim.step()
        if isinstance(self.optim, SkipStepOptimizer):
            self.record_metric("step skipped", self.optim.step_skipped, namespace="optim")

        self.model.post_optim_step()

    def zero_grads(self):
        assert self.optim is not None, "zero_grads() is not available in eval_only mode"
        self.optim.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

    def model_forward(
        self, input_ids: torch.Tensor, labels: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None, **kwargs
    ) -> Union[torch.Tensor, LMOutputWithLoss]:
        """
        Run a forward pass on a micro-batch, returning the logits.
        """
        with self._model_forward_context():
            return self.model(input_ids, labels=labels, **kwargs)

    @lru_cache
    def num_flops_per_token(self, seq_len: int) -> Optional[int]:
        try:
            return self.model.num_flops_per_token(seq_len)
        except NotImplementedError as ex:
            warn_once(f"Unable to estimate num flops per token: {ex}")
            return None

    def global_num_flops_in_batch(self, batch: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[int]:
        global_num_tokens = self.trainer.data_loader.global_num_tokens_in_batch(batch)
        if global_num_tokens is None:
            return None
        flops_per_token = self.num_flops_per_token(seq_len=batch["input_ids"].shape[1])
        return flops_per_token * global_num_tokens if flops_per_token is not None else None

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _train_microbatch_context(
        self, micro_batch_idx: int, num_micro_batches: int
    ) -> Generator[None, None, None]:
        is_last_mb = micro_batch_idx == num_micro_batches - 1
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            if isinstance(self.model, FSDPModule):
                assert self.dp_config is not None
                # On the last backward FSDP waits on pending gradient reduction and clears internal data
                # data structures for backward prefetching.
                self.model.set_is_last_backward(is_last_mb)
                # For HSDP we can delay the gradients all-reduce until the final micro-batch.
                if self.dp_config.name == DataParallelType.hsdp:
                    self.model.set_requires_all_reduce(is_last_mb)
            elif isinstance(self.model, DDP):
                # For DDP, only sync gradients on the final micro-batch.
                if not is_last_mb:
                    stack.enter_context(self.model.no_sync())

            yield

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _eval_batch_context(self) -> Generator[None, None, None]:
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            stack.enter_context(torch.no_grad())
            yield

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def _model_forward_context(self) -> Generator[None, None, None]:
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            if self.autocast_precision is not None:
                stack.enter_context(torch.autocast(self.device.type, dtype=self.autocast_precision))
            yield

    def _get_state_dict(
        self, sd_options: dist_cp_sd.StateDictOptions, optim: bool = True
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        state_dict: Dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": dist_cp_sd.get_model_state_dict(self.model, options=sd_options),
        }
        if optim:
            assert self.optim is not None, "cannot include optimizer state in eval_only mode"
            state_dict["optim"] = dist_cp_sd.get_optimizer_state_dict(
                self.model, self.optim, options=sd_options
            )
        return state_dict

    def _clip_grad_norm(
        self, max_grad_norm: float, norm_type: float = 2.0, foreach: Optional[bool] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        if isinstance(self.model, FSDP):
            return self.model.clip_grad_norm_(max_grad_norm)

        # Adapted from https://github.com/pytorch/torchtitan/blob/2a4437014e66bcf88a3f0419b816266e6326d539/torchtitan/utils.py#L348

        parameters = [p for p in self.model.parameters()]
        grads = [p.grad for p in parameters if p.grad is not None]

        total_norm = nn.utils.get_total_norm(
            grads, norm_type=norm_type, error_if_nonfinite=False, foreach=foreach
        )

        # If total_norm is a DTensor, the placements must be `torch.distributed._tensor.ops.math_ops._NormPartial`.
        # We can simply reduce the DTensor to get the total norm in this tensor's process group
        # and then convert it to a local tensor.
        # NOTE: It has two purposes:
        #       1. to make sure the total norm is computed correctly when PP is used (see below)
        #       2. to return a reduced total_norm tensor whose .item() would return the correct value
        if isinstance(total_norm, DTensor):
            # Will reach here if any non-PP parallelism is used.
            # If only using PP, total_norm will be a local tensor.

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _assert_no_unowned_fp8_weight_stores(model: nn.Module) -> None:
    """
    Fail loudly if the model contains FP8 weight stores (e.g. :class:`MXFP8Linear`, used by
    ``AttentionConfig(name="fused_v2", mxfp8_projections=True)``) whose weights are trained only by
    the OLMoDDP fused optimizer.

    :class:`TransformerTrainModule` uses an ordinary optimizer that never discovers these side
    stores, so their frozen anchor weights would silently never update. Such models must use
    :class:`~olmo_core.train.train_module.OLMoDDPTrainModule` instead.
    """
    offending: list[str] = []
    seen_store_ids: set = set()
    for module_name, module in model.named_modules():
        named_stores = getattr(module, "named_fp8_weight_stores", None)
        if named_stores is None:
            continue
        for _, store in named_stores():
            if id(store) in seen_store_ids:
                continue
            seen_store_ids.add(id(store))
            if getattr(store, "optimizer_enabled", False):
                offending.append(module_name or "<root>")
                break

    if offending:
        raise OLMoConfigurationError(
            f"Model modules {offending} use FP8 weight stores whose weights are trained only by "
            "the OLMoDDP fused optimizer, but TransformerTrainModule uses an ordinary optimizer "
            "that would leave them frozen. Use OLMoDDPTrainModule for these models."
        )

 ### Fixed
 
+- `TransformerTrainModule.train_batch` now normalizes the loss by the number of loss tokens in the global batch (all-reduced over the data parallel group) instead of the local rank's count, so the training objective is the global token mean rather than the mean of per-rank token means. This matches `OLMoDDPTrainModule` and `MultimodalTransformerTrainModule`. Nothing changes when every rank has the same number of loss tokens (e.g. pretraining without label masking); with label masking (SFT), the loss and gradients no longer depend on how instances are split across ranks.
 - The extra token rows of `SplitVocabEmbedding` (`TransformerConfig.n_extra_vocab > 0`) are now initialized by the model's init method like the base rows, instead of always with `init_std`, so they start at the same scale under `nanochat`, `llama`, `llama_depth`, `fan_in` and `normalized` init. The `normal` init is unchanged. muP and CompletedP now classify both rows as embeddings instead of raising.
 - Fixed int32 pointer-offset overflow in the valid-prefix SwiGLU Triton kernels (forward, dynamic-row forward, and backward). Row and column indices are widened to int64 before stride multiplication, so no-gradient MoE activation buffers with 2^31 or more elements (for example 1,048,576 rows by 2,048 BF16 columns) no longer read or write wrapped addresses.
 - Activation checkpointing now preserves the RNG state across recomputation whenever dropout is active (including `ResidualStream.masked_dropout`), so the recomputed forward replays the same dropout masks as the original forward instead of drawing new ones. Previously this was done only for EMO routing.

def get_labels(batch: Dict[str, Any], label_ignore_index: int = -100) -> torch.Tensor:
    # Labels are just input IDs shifted to the left (first item is ignored).
    labels, label_mask, attention_mask, instance_mask = (
        batch["input_ids"].clone(),
        batch.get("label_mask"),
        batch.get("attention_mask"),
        batch.get("instance_mask"),
    )
    if label_mask is not None:
        labels.masked_fill_(~label_mask, label_ignore_index)
    if attention_mask is not None:
        labels.masked_fill_(attention_mask == 0.0, label_ignore_index)
    if instance_mask is not None:
        labels.masked_fill_(~instance_mask.unsqueeze(-1), value=label_ignore_index)
    # Shift and pad.
    return F.pad(labels[..., 1:], (0, 1, 0, 0), value=label_ignore_index)

Each rank r computes local_sum_r (sum of per-token losses on its instances). Its loss is divided by global_N / dp_ws, so ce_batch_loss_r = local_sum_r * dp_ws / global_N. Sum over ranks: (Σ_r local_sum_r) * dp_ws / global_N = global_sum * dp_ws / global_N. Dividing by dp_ws gives global_sum / global_N = global token mean = ref_loss (F.cross_entropy with default mean reduction over non-ignored tokens). ✓ 

And gradients: each rank's backward accumulates grad of (local_sum_r * dp_ws / global_N). After DP gradient averaging (all-reduce mean), the effective gradient = (1/dp_ws) Σ_r ∇(local_sum_r) * dp_ws / global_N = ∇(global_sum) / global_N = gradient of global token mean. ✓ Exactly matching ref_loss.backward() where ref_loss = F.cross_entropy(..., ignore_index) = global_sum / global_N.

Why divide by DP world size? Because gradients are averaged across DP ranks (DDP all-reduce mean / FSDP reduce-scatter mean). Each rank's local backward produces grad of (local_sum / (global_N/dp_ws)) = (dp_ws/global_N)·∇local_sum. - Why it matters: pretraining without label masking → every rank has the same count (labels are dense), nothing changes. - Why divide by DP world size: DP (DDP/FSDP/HSDP) averages gradients across DP ranks; pre-dividing compensates so that post-averaging gradient = ∇ of global token mean.

设 DP 组有 \( R \) 个 rank，rank \( r \) 有 \( n_r \) 个 loss token，其 token 损失之和为 \( S_r \)，全局 \( G = \sum_r n_r \)。

旧目标（#957 前）:
\[ J_{\text{old}} = \frac{1}{R}\sum_{r=1}^{R} \frac{S_r}{n_r} \]

新目标（#957 后）:
\[ J_{\text{new}} = \frac{1}{G}\sum_{r=1}^{R} S_r \]

执行路径：每个 rank 的 backward 累计的是 \( \nabla S_r \cdot \frac{R}{G} \)（因为 div_factor = G/R），DP 梯度平均后:
\[ \frac{1}{R}\sum_r \nabla S_r \cdot \frac{R}{G} = \frac{\nabla \sum_r S_r}{G} = \nabla J_{\text{new}} \]

Difference illustration: rank A has 1 token, rank B has 7 tokens. Old: (S_A/1 + S_B/7)/2 — the single token on A gets weight 1/2 vs each token on B gets 1/14: A 的 token 权重是 B 的 7 倍。New: every token gets 1/8. So the new objective is the standard "mean over all tokens" — same as what a single-process run on the whole batch would compute (F.cross_entropy default mean).
